heightDetails: Height of the viewer canvas, in pixels.
defaultEnvDetails: Generated env map for material reflections.
skyboxDetails: RGBE .hdr image rendered as the background and used for reflections.
envmapDetails: Optional separate HDR for material reflections only.
fovModeDetails: Auto fits the model. Custom uses the FOV value below.
allowZoomDetails: Off also hides the zoom in / out buttons.
scrollTouchDetails: Allow vertical scroll when dragging on the canvas.
animationSelectorDetails: Shows the active clip in the mini toolbar; click it to pick another. Off means the model does not animate at all.
axesDetails: Orientation indicator shown in the corner of the viewer.
zoomButtonsDetails: Hidden while “Allow zoom” is off, under Controls.
screenshotDetails: Downloads a PNG of the current view.
resetViewDetails: Returns the camera to its starting angle and zoom.
positionsHelp: Positions — or use “Move controls” under the preview to drag each one, including the order within a spot.
animationIndexDetails: Which clip plays on load, counted as the switcher lists them: 1 = first, 2 = second… 0 = none. Needs “Animation clip name / switcher” (under Control bar) to be on.
placementDetails: Where the model goes when a shopper opens AR. Wall suits art, mirrors, shelves and TVs. Wall placement works on Android; iPhones place the model as its .usdz file says, which for Shopify's own files is the floor.
iosSrcDetails: Used by Quick Look on iOS Safari. Upload separately to Shopify Files.
variantDetails: Name of a KHR_materials_variants variant in the model.
fixSkinnedDetails: Recalculate bbox using skeleton weights (rigged models).
